verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה׀ חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נוּדוּ הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’êḵ tō·mə·rū lə·nap̄·šî nū·ḏū har·ḵem ṣip·pō·wr
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of David In the LORD I take refuge How then can you say to me Flee like a bird to your mountain
verses.literalPt: NO SENHOR confio; como dizeis à minha alma: Fugi para a vossa montanha como pássaro?

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־ יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·rə·ḵūn qe·šeṯ kō·wn·nū ḥiṣ·ṣām ‘al- ye·ṯer lî·rō·wṯ bə·mōw- ’ō·p̄el lə·yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: For behold the wicked bend their bows They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que os ímpios armam o arco, põem as flechas na corda, para com elas atirarem, às escuras, aos retos de coração.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה־ פָּעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî haš·šā·ṯō·wṯ yê·hā·rê·sūn ṣad·dîq mah- pā·‘āl
verses.literal: If the foundations are destroyed what can the righteous do
verses.literalPt: Se forem destruídos os fundamentos, que poderá fazer o justo?

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·hê·ḵal qā·ḏə·šōw Yah·weh baš·šā·ma·yim kis·’ōw ‘ê·nāw ye·ḥĕ·zū ‘ap̄·‘ap·pāw yiḇ·ḥă·nū bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The LORD is in His holy temple the LORD is on His heavenly throne His eyes are watching closely they examine the sons of men
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR está no seu santo templo, o trono do SENHOR está nos céus; os seus olhos estão atentos, e as suas pálpebras provam os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣad·dîq yiḇ·ḥān wə·rā·šā‘ wə·’ō·hêḇ ḥā·mās śā·nə·’āh nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked His soul hates the lover of violence
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR prova o justo; porém ao ímpio e ao que ama a violência odeia a sua alma.

verses.original: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־ רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yam·ṭêr ‘al- rə·šā·‘îm pa·ḥîm ’êš wə·ḡā·p̄ə·rîṯ wə·rū·aḥ zil·‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ mə·nāṯ kō·w·sām
verses.literal: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur a scorching wind will be their portion . . .
verses.literalPt: Sobre os ímpios fará chover laços, fogo, enxofre e vento tempestuoso; isto será a porção do seu copo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṣad·dîq Yah·weh ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ ’ā·hêḇ yā·šār ye·ḥĕ·zū p̄ā·nê·mōw
verses.literal: For the LORD is righteous He loves justice The upright will see His face
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR é justo, e ama a justiça; o seu rosto olha para os retos.
